item.title: "Si me ves, llora". La sequía europea está haciendo reaparecer piedras grabadas hace siglos para advertir de futuras hambrunas
item.description: Buena parte de las grandes ciudades del viejo continente se construyeron en torno a un río, un auténtico vector de vida: sirve para el abastecimiento de agua, el regadío en agricultura y ganadería y también para el transporte de mercancías y personas. Si hay río, hay vida. Cuando el río se seca, malo: aparecen los problemas. Por eso, a lo largo de los siglos quienes vivían alrededor de los ríos de Europa Central dejaron un mensaje de advertencia en el mejor lugar posible para el futuro: en esas piedras que quedaban expuestas cuando el nivel del agua era anormalmente bajo. item.title: Hurricane Katrina forced New Orleans’ Charity Hospital to close in 2005; now it is being transformed into a $500 million medical research hub
item.description: The historic Charity Hospital in New Orleans is set to undergo a remarkable transformation into a cutting-edge medical research facility. Spearheaded by Tulane University, this ambitious $500 million project aims to establish a vibrant biomedical innovation hub, with construction kicking off this fall and projected completion by 2029. This redevelopment not only honors the landmark's legacy but also demonstrates a robust commitment to improving healthcare for the Gulf South community. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Scientists spent 100 years discovering animals, reshaping where we see Earth’s biodiversity hotspots
item.description: A groundbreaking study has unveiled that taxonomic advancements have reshaped worldwide biodiversity maps over the last century. While reptile and amphibian diversity has markedly changed, bird and mammal distributions have remained mostly unchanged. Australia and Southeast Asia have been identified as key biodiversity hotspots for these groups. Moreover, factors influencing species richness are also shifting, with precipitation emerging as more crucial. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
